Material.description: A material: a name and the user's values per tool.

name.description: The material's name, unique in the library (upper or lower case don't matter).

tools.description: Values for the tools used with this material, one entry per library tool.

uid.description: What projects name the material by: 16 lowercase hex digits, never changed.

MaterialTool.description: One tool's values in a material.

stepover.description: Pocket stepover, a fraction of the tool diameter: more than 0, at most 1.

description: Schema version 2. Older files load through Chipload's migrations; this schema describes only the current version.

default_material.description: The name of the material new projects start with. Null: none.

schema_version.description: The version of the file format. Chipload upgrades older files when it reads them, and refuses newer ones.

written_by.description: The Chipload version that wrote the file.

title: Chipload materials
